description: City aims to keep Dutch elm disease increase below two percent.
Preventative tree injections cost $6,800 annually per tree.
Pest Management Reserve is $700,000 of its $1 million annual goal.

chips.text: The $1 million reserve goal was set for Emerald Ash Borer.
Private citizens cannot currently purchase DED injections for public trees.
Effectiveness results of DED test injections are still pending.
Other cities without rapid DED removal lost five percent of their elm canopy.
Staff is developing an intake process for private DED injection requests.

description: Committee supports continued Dutch Elm Disease funding to Council.
Will periodically review annual report items, including dark sky policy.

chips.text: Committee member noted eight annual report items lacked updates.
Dark sky policy discussion focused on protecting flora and fauna.
Ian Judd-Henrey will draft letter supporting Dutch Elm Disease funding.

description: A committee member raises environmental concerns about AI data centers.

chips.text: AI data centers cause climate change, resource demand, pollution from energy and water use.
